rows.question: Can seven complete sets of four be assembled? There are 27 pencils available.
rows.fact: 27 pencils available; each set needs 4 pencils.

rows.question: Are exactly nine slips left? There were 15; six were removed. Someone may have removed others.
rows.fact: 15 total; 6 removed; unknown if others removed.

rows.question: Are 31 seats left? There were 45 vacant seats; 14 guests then sat down and nobody else moved.
rows.fact: 45 vacant seats; 14 sat down; 31 left.

rows.question: Is Nur an editor? Every editor has an access card. Nur has a card; contractors can have cards too.
rows.fact: Every editor has an access card. Nur has a card.

rows.question: Is kiosk M powered? Every operating kiosk is powered. M is operating.
rows.fact: Every operating kiosk is powered. M is operating.

rows.question: Is parcel G insured? Every insured parcel bears a seal. G has no seal.
rows.fact: Every insured parcel bears a seal. G has no seal.

rows.question: Was the first train after 14:30? The first train arrived at 2:35 p.m. that day.
rows.fact: The first train arrived at 2:35 p.m. that day.

rows.question: Was the hall vacant at ten? The only count occurred at 10:12 and found it empty.
rows.fact: The only count was at 10:12, not at 10:00.

rows.question: Did the first visitor arrive before 07:15? The first visitor arrived at 7:20 a.m.
rows.fact: The first visitor arrived at 7:20 a.m.

rows.question: Did the journal report a cancellation? The journal lists a postponement only. Later the organizer cancelled the event.
rows.fact: The journal lists a postponement only.

rows.question: Was the sample pure gold? A brochure repeats the owner's untested guess that it was pure gold.
rows.fact: A brochure repeats an untested guess, not a verified fact.

rows.question: Was the blue folder handed over? A witness saw the recipient accept the blue folder, although the tracking screen said pending.
rows.fact: Witness saw acceptance, tracking says pending.

rows.question: Did every tested valve pass? Only valves A and B were tested and both passed.
rows.fact: Only valves A and B were tested and both passed.

rows.question: Were all ten exhibits displayed? Nine were displayed and one remained boxed all day.
rows.fact: Nine were displayed and one remained boxed all day.

rows.question: Were all the cans sealed? Five of seven were examined and found sealed; the other two were never examined.
rows.fact: Five of seven cans examined were sealed; two unexamined.

rows.question: Did the sale alone cause the increase? A discount and a newspaper feature started together before orders increased.
rows.fact: A discount and feature started before orders increased.

rows.question: Did tomorrow's concert cause last week's noise by its performance? The concert's only performance is tomorrow.
rows.fact: The concert's only performance is tomorrow.

rows.question: Did trigger Z start the motor in this test? The motor started in the test and trigger Z was its only possible cause.
rows.fact: The motor started and trigger Z was its only possible cause.
